title: Borrow subtracts one from positive values
statement: For every finite bit word $b$ whose little-endian value is positive, the little-endian value of the word produced by the borrow pass started with borrow bit $1$, plus $1$, equals the value of $b$.
replaced:
For every bit word $w$ whose little-endian value is positive, the word produced by the
borrow pass entered with a set flag has little-endian value exactly one less than the
value of $w$.
